scope: one source-only future-path preparation and mask coverage audit; no training
mutation_selection: first eight source IDs ordered by SHA256(source_id), no label-based selection

catalogue_screen.purpose: operational screen for exact finite-mask integration; not a statistical confidence bound or performance criterion
catalogue_screen.invalid_policy: retain all rows; report exact unknown rates over all rows and valid rows separately

failure_policy: identity, reconstruction, leakage, encoding or integrity failures stop preparation; preserve partial outputs; catalogue screen failure rejects current finite-catalogue hypothesis but does not erase valid prepared data
public_output: aggregate counts/errors, input/source/output file hashes only; no raw, identities, masks or row-level results
